text.text: Sicily is an island off of the southern coast of mainland Italy. It had several city-states, but the biggest and most powerful was a city called Syracuse.

atoms.b: In 415 BC, several small city-states in Sicily went to ((++war wall)) with Syracuse.
These city-states asked their ally Athens for ((++reinforcement repetition)) because Syracuse was a very large and powerful city.
In response, Syracuse asked for help from ((++Sparta Sicily)) to fight the Athenian forces.

feedback.finish: With Spartan and Athenian armies fighting in Sicily, the Peace of Nicias was over.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The war in Sicily ended with the total defeat of the Athenian army and navy at the hands of a Spartan general.
Over the next few years, the Athenians were able to rebuild. However, the Spartans had now allied with the Persians, giving them an even stronger army.
atoms.sound: Over the next few years, the Athenians were able to rebuild. However, the Spartans had now ally'd with the Persians, giving them an even stronger army.

atoms.text: With Persian support, the Spartans were able to take Athens’ farmlands and laid siege to the city. Facing starvation, Athens surrendered, ending the Peloponnesian wars.
atoms.sound: With Persian support, the Spartans were able to take Athens’s farmlands and laid siege to the city. Facing starvation, Athens surrendered, ending the Peloponnesian wars.

atoms.a: Who won the war in Sicily?

b: They wanted to fight someone else.
